name: Scroll Gallery
tagline: A gallery page where your pictures fly from one 3D scene into the next as you scroll: a runway, a jukebox, a sphere.
youSay: /scroll-gallery A lookbook for our autumn–winter collection, from the photos in ~/Pictures/aw27
whatYouGet: A gallery page in about four scenes: your pictures laid out as a table of prints, a runway of silk panels, a jukebox, an acrylic ribbon, a sphere and more, flying from one shape into the next as you scroll
Pictures as real objects in one studio light: photo paper, record sleeves, thick acrylic, glazed tiles, silk that hangs and sways
Click any picture to bring it forward with its words; an index that brings any picture into view; type, colours and scenery chosen for your subject
Your own pictures imported for free, or a matching series generated for you; a headless check and a scroll-through video, as a static site you can host anywhere
goodFit: Portfolios, lookbooks, collections, catalogues, album shelves and photo series of 6 to 40 pictures
Brands and creators who want a gallery people remember, and a page that plays as a video
notFor: Hundreds of pictures, or a gallery people search and filter
Pages that must be light: it loads three.js and draws in WebGL
youBring: What the gallery shows, and your pictures if you have them
Optional: the brand's name, colours and tone, and a reference you like
needs: Your own pictures, or Skillsmart credits (20 a picture)

generates.estimate: 20 a picture: 240 for 12, nothing with your own

network.purpose: the three.js library the gallery is drawn with
playwright-core for the headless check, installed once into a cache
